usajmo-2013-q1.summary: Can two integers $a,b$ make both $a^5b+3$ and $ab^5+3$ integral cubes? The integers and the cube roots may have either sign.
usajmo-2013-q1.summaryZh: 是否存在整数 $a,b$，使 $a^5b+3$ 和 $ab^5+3$ 均为某个整数的立方？这里整数和立方根均可为负数或零。

methods.title: Multiply two restricted cubic residues
methods.titleZh: 将两个受限的剩余类相乘
steps: Every cube modulo $9$ is $0,1$, or $-1$, as one sees by cubing $3k,3k+1,3k-1$. If $3\mid a$, then $a^5b+3\equiv3\pmod9$, impossible. Likewise $3\mid b$ is impossible by the other expression.

Now both cubes would be units modulo $9$, so each must be $1$ or $-1$. Subtracting $3$ shows that both $a^5b$ and $ab^5$ have residues in $\{5,7\}$. Multiplying two members of this set gives $7,8$, or $4$ modulo $9$.
But their product is $(ab)^6$. Since $3\nmid ab$, its cube is $\pm1\pmod9$ and its sixth power is $1\pmod9$. This contradicts every possible product residue.
stepsZh: 将 $3k,3k+1,3k-1$ 分别立方可知，整数的立方模 $9$ 只可能为 $0,1,-1$。若 $3\mid a$，则 $a^5b+3\equiv3\pmod9$，矛盾；若 $3\mid b$，考察另一式同样矛盾。
因此两立方数都不被 $3$ 整除，模 $9$ 只能取 $1$ 或 $-1$。减去 $3$ 后，$a^5b$ 与 $ab^5$ 的余数均在 $\{5,7\}$ 中。取其中两个数相乘，模 $9$ 的结果只可能是 $7,8,4$。
然而这两个数之积为 $(ab)^6$。因 $3\nmid ab$，其三次方模 $9$ 为 $\pm1$，所以六次方必为 $1$，与上列三种结果均矛盾。

usajmo-2013-q2.summary: Fill an $m\times n$ rectangular grid with nonnegative integers, where $m,n\ge1$. Values in cells sharing a side must differ by at most $1$. Every cell with no strictly smaller side-neighbour must contain zero. How many fillings satisfy both rules?
usajmo-2013-q2.summaryZh: 在 $m\times n$ 的矩形方格中填入非负整数，其中 $m,n\ge1$。共边两格的数相差至多 $1$；若某格没有比它小的共边邻格，则该格必须填零。符合条件的填法共有多少种？

methods.title: Recover the filling from its zero cells
methods.titleZh: 由零格集合恢复整张表
steps: In any legal filling a cell of minimum value must be zero. Let $S$ be the nonempty set of all zero cells, and consider a cell marked $d$. A path from it to $S$ needs at least $d$ steps, since each step can lower the value by at most one.

Whenever the current value is positive it has a smaller neighbour by the second rule. That neighbour has value exactly one less by the first rule. Continue for $d$ steps to reach zero. Thus the value in every cell equals its shortest side-step distance to $S$.

Conversely, choose any nonempty set $S$ and fill with these shortest distances. Neighbouring distances differ by at most one, by extending a shortest path by a single edge. A positive-distance cell has a smaller neighbour on such a path. The zeros are exactly $S$, so different choices give different fillings. Of the $2^{mn}$ subsets only the empty one is excluded.
stepsZh: 任一合法填法中，全表最小值所在的格子一定为零。设 $S$ 为所有零格构成的非空集合。若某格填了 $d$，因为一步至多下降 $1$，从该格沿共边走到 $S$ 至少需要 $d$ 步。
只要当前格为正数，依第二条规则就一定有更小的邻格，依第一条规则那个数恰小 $1$。如此走 $d$ 步便到达零格。因此每格的数恰是它到 $S$ 的最短共边步数。
反过来，任取非空集合 $S$，按到它的最短步数填表。相邻格可彼此多走一步再接上最短路，所以距离之差至多为一。距离为正的格子在最短路上一定有距离更小的邻格。零格集合正是 $S$，不同集合对应不同填法。在 $2^{mn}$ 个子集中仅空集不能取。

usajmo-2013-q3.summary: In triangle $ABC$ choose $P$ on $BC$, $Q$ on $CA$, and $R$ on $AB$. On segment $AP$, let $X$ be the second intersection with the circle through $A,Q,R$, and let $Y,Z$ be the second intersections (besides $P$) with the circles through $B,R,P$ and $C,P,Q$, respectively. Prove the internal-division formula $YX/XZ=BP/PC$ whenever the indicated ratio is defined.
usajmo-2013-q3.summaryZh: 在三角形 $ABC$ 的边 $BC,CA,AB$ 上分别取点 $P,Q,R$。线段 $AP$ 与圆 $AQR$ 除 $A$ 外再交于 $X$，与圆 $BRP,CPQ$ 除 $P$ 外分别再交于 $Y,Z$。证明在比值有定义时，$YX/XZ=BP/PC$。
usajmo-2013-q3.answer: $PC\cdot YX=BP\cdot XZ$. If $Y\ne Z$, this gives $YX/XZ=BP/PC$.
usajmo-2013-q3.answerZh: $PC\cdot YX=BP\cdot XZ$。当 $Y\ne Z$ 时，即有 $YX/XZ=BP/PC$。

methods.title: Interpolate the equation of the circle through A
methods.titleZh: 对过 A 的圆方程作线性插值
steps: Use $A$ as vector origin. If $O$ is the centre of the circle $AQR$, each point $T$ on that circle satisfies $|T|^2=2O\cdot T$, by expanding $|T-O|^2=|O|^2$. Define the linear function $L(T)=2O\cdot T$. Since $R,Q,X$ lie on the rays $AB,AC,AP$, scaling their vectors gives $L(B)=AB\cdot AR$, $L(C)=AC\cdot AQ$, and $L(P)=AP\cdot AX$.
The power of $A$ with respect to circle $BRP$, using its two secants $AB$ and $AP$, gives $AB\cdot AR=AP\cdot AY$. Circle $CPQ$ gives $AC\cdot AQ=AP\cdot AZ$.
Write $b=BP$ and $c=PC$. The point dividing segment $BC$ in this ratio has vector $P=(cB+bC)/(b+c)$. Apply $L$, substitute the preceding identities, and cancel $AP>0$ to obtain $(b+c)AX=c\,AY+b\,AZ$.

All three points lie on the same ray from $A$. If $Y\ne Z$, the weighted average places $X$ strictly between them. Subtracting $AY$ and $AX$ in turn, then taking absolute values, gives $YX=b\,YZ/(b+c)$ and $XZ=c\,YZ/(b+c)$. If $Y=Z$ the same identity forces $X=Y=Z$: the cross-multiplied equality still holds, while the quotient would be $0/0$.
stepsZh: 以 $A$ 为向量原点，设 $O$ 是圆 $AQR$ 的圆心。圆上任一点 $T$ 满足 $|T-O|^2=|O|^2$，展开即 $|T|^2=2O\cdot T$。定义线性函数 $L(T)=2O\cdot T$。因 $R,Q,X$ 分别在射线 $AB,AC,AP$ 上，将对应向量按长度成比例放大，得 $L(B)=AB\cdot AR$、$L(C)=AC\cdot AQ$、$L(P)=AP\cdot AX$。
对圆 $BRP$，从 $A$ 作割线 $AB,AP$，由点幂得 $AB\cdot AR=AP\cdot AY$。同理对圆 $CPQ$ 有 $AC\cdot AQ=AP\cdot AZ$。
记 $b=BP,c=PC$，按此比例内分 $BC$ 的点向量为 $P=(cB+bC)/(b+c)$。两边作用 $L$，代入前述各式并约去 $AP>0$，得 $(b+c)AX=c\,AY+b\,AZ$。
三点同在从 $A$ 出发的射线上。当 $Y\ne Z$ 时，此加权平均表明 $X$ 严格位于两者之间。分别作差并取绝对值，得 $YX=b\,YZ/(b+c)$、$XZ=c\,YZ/(b+c)$，相除即证。若 $Y=Z$，同一等式迫使 $X=Y=Z$，此时交叉相乘的结论仍成立，而直接相除为 $0/0$。

figure.alt: The three circumcircles intersect the cevian AP at X, Y and Z. P divides BC, Q lies on CA and R on AB.
figure.altZh: 三圆与线段 AP 的第二交点分别为 X、Y、Z。P 在 BC 上，Q 在 CA 上，R 在 AB 上。

usajmo-2013-q4.summary: Let $f(n)$ count ordered lists with entries drawn from $1,2,4,8,\ldots$ whose sum is $n$. For example the one-term list $(4)$ and the two-term list $(2,2)$ are different. Find the least $n>2013$ with $f(n)$ odd.
usajmo-2013-q4.summaryZh: 令 $f(n)$ 表示各项均为 $2$ 的非负整数次幂（包含 $2^0=1$）且总和为 $n$ 的有序列表个数。例如 $(4)$ 与 $(2,2)$ 是不同的列表。求使 $f(n)$ 为奇数的最小整数 $n>2013$。

methods.title: Pair unequal powers in the parity recurrence
methods.titleZh: 在奇偶递推中将不等的幂配对
steps: Allow the empty list at $0$, so $f(0)=1$. Choosing the last part gives $f(n)=\sum_{2^j\le n} f(n-2^j)$ for $n>0$, with $j\ge0$. We claim $f(n)$ is odd exactly when $n+1$ is a power of two, true at $0$.

Assume this for smaller inputs. The odd terms in the recurrence correspond to ordered exponent pairs $(j,k)$ satisfying $n+1=2^j+2^k$, because $n-2^j+1$ must be a power of two. Swapping $j,k$ pairs up all solutions with unequal exponents. Thus the parity equals the number of diagonal pairs $j=k$, modulo two.
There is one such pair when $n+1=2^{j+1}$ and none otherwise. This proves the claim by induction. The first power of two above $2014$ is $2048$, giving $n=2047$.
stepsZh: 把空列表作为 $0$ 的一种写法，得 $f(0)=1$。按末项分类，$n>0$ 时 $f(n)=\sum_{2^j\le n}f(n-2^j)$，其中 $j\ge0$。下面证明 $f(n)$ 为奇数当且仅当 $n+1$ 是二的幂；$n=0$ 时成立。
假设结论对较小的输入成立。递推式中的奇数项对应于有序指数对 $(j,k)$ 满足 $n+1=2^j+2^k$，因为 $n-2^j+1$ 必为二的幂。交换 $j,k$ 可将所有不等指数的解两两配对。因此奇偶性只由 $j=k$ 的解数决定。
若 $n+1=2^{j+1}$ 则这样的解恰有一个，否则没有。归纳完成。大于 $2014$ 的最小二的幂是 $2048$，故所求 $n=2047$。

methods.title: Invert a formal series modulo two
methods.titleZh: 在模二形式幂级数中求逆
steps: In power series with coefficients modulo two, set $S=x+x^2+x^4+x^8+\cdots$. Lists of length $k$ have generating function $S^k$. Thus $F=\sum_{n\ge0}f(n)x^n=1+S+S^2+\cdots$ satisfies $(1+S)F=1$. Each coefficient uses only finitely many list lengths.

Squaring in characteristic two cancels every mixed term, so $S^2=x^2+x^4+x^8+\cdots=S+x$. It follows that $S(1+S)=x$, hence $F=S/x=1+x+x^3+x^7+\cdots$. Its nonzero coefficients occur exactly at $2^k-1$, and the first such exponent above $2013$ is $2047$.
stepsZh: 在系数按模二计算的形式幂级数中，令 $S=x+x^2+x^4+x^8+\cdots$。长度恰为 $k$ 的列表对应生成函数 $S^k$，故 $F=\sum_{n\ge0}f(n)x^n=1+S+S^2+\cdots$ 满足 $(1+S)F=1$。每一项系数只涉及有限种列表长度。
模二平方时所有交叉项成对抵消，故 $S^2=x^2+x^4+x^8+\cdots=S+x$。因此 $S(1+S)=x$，得到 $F=S/x=1+x+x^3+x^7+\cdots$。系数非零的下标恰为 $2^k-1$，第一个超过 $2013$ 的是 $2047$。

usajmo-2013-q5.summary: On a semicircle with diameter $XY$ the boundary points have arc order $X,A,B,Y$. Segments $AY$ and $BX$ cross at $P$, and $Z$ is the perpendicular projection of $P$ onto $XY$. Choose $C$ on the semicircle so that $XC\perp AZ$, and put $Q=AY\cap XC$. Prove $BY/XP+CY/XQ=AY/AX$.
usajmo-2013-q5.summaryZh: 半圆的直径是 $XY$，其弧上各点依次为 $X,A,B,Y$。线段 $AY,BX$ 交于 $P$，从 $P$ 向 $XY$ 作垂线，垂足为 $Z$。取半圆上的 $C$，使 $XC\perp AZ$，并令 $Q=AY\cap XC$。证明 $BY/XP+CY/XQ=AY/AX$。

methods.title: Use the slopes of the two rays from X
methods.titleZh: 用从 X 出发的两条射线的斜率
steps: Use $X=(0,0),Y=(1,0)$ with the semicircle above the horizontal axis. Write $AY$ as $y=t(1-x)$, $t>0$, and let $u$ be the slope of $XB$. The equation of the semicircle is $x^2+y^2=x$. Intersecting it with $AY$ gives $A=(t^2/(1+t^2),t/(1+t^2))$. Also $Z=(t/(t+u),0)$ by intersecting $y=ux$ with $AY$ and dropping vertically.
Let $v$ be the slope of $XC$. Perpendicularity to $AZ$ gives $v=(Z_x-A_x)/A_y=(1-tu)/(t+u)$, hence $t(u+v)=1-uv$. The specified arc order gives $0<u<1/t$, so both slopes $u,v$ are positive.

For either slope $w=u$ or $v$, let its ray cut the semicircle at $K$ and $AY$ at $H$. The intersection coordinates are $K=(1,w)/(1+w^2)$ and $H=t(1,w)/(t+w)$. Therefore $KY=w/\sqrt{1+w^2}$ and $XH=t\sqrt{1+w^2}/(t+w)$, whence $KY/XH=w(t+w)/(t(1+w^2))$.

From $t=(1-uv)/(u+v)$ follows $t+u=(1+u^2)/(u+v)$ and $t+v=(1+v^2)/(u+v)$. Substitution makes the ratios for $B,P$ and $C,Q$ equal to $u/(t(u+v))$ and $v/(t(u+v))$. Their sum is $1/t$, which equals $AY/AX$ by the coordinates of $A$.
stepsZh: 取 $X=(0,0),Y=(1,0)$，半圆位于横轴上方。设 $AY$ 的方程为 $y=t(1-x)$，其中 $t>0$，$XB$ 的斜率为 $u$。半圆方程为 $x^2+y^2=x$，与 $AY$ 联立得 $A=(t^2/(1+t^2),t/(1+t^2))$。将 $y=ux$ 与 $AY$ 联立再垂直投影，得 $Z=(t/(t+u),0)$。
设 $XC$ 的斜率为 $v$。由它与 $AZ$ 垂直，有 $v=(Z_x-A_x)/A_y=(1-tu)/(t+u)$，即 $t(u+v)=1-uv$。由题设弧序得 $0<u<1/t$，所以 $u,v$ 均为正。
对 $w=u,v$ 中任一斜率，设对应射线与半圆交于 $K$，与 $AY$ 交于 $H$。联立方程可得 $K=(1,w)/(1+w^2)$、$H=t(1,w)/(t+w)$。于是 $KY=w/\sqrt{1+w^2}$，$XH=t\sqrt{1+w^2}/(t+w)$，故 $KY/XH=w(t+w)/(t(1+w^2))$。
由 $t=(1-uv)/(u+v)$ 得 $t+u=(1+u^2)/(u+v)$、$t+v=(1+v^2)/(u+v)$。代入上式后，对应 $B,P$ 及 $C,Q$ 的两个比值分别为 $u/(t(u+v))$ 和 $v/(t(u+v))$，相加即 $1/t$，而由 $A$ 的坐标可知 $AY/AX=1/t$。

methods.title: Split a cosine difference
methods.titleZh: 将余弦差角公式拆成两项
steps: Normalise $XY=1$ and put $\alpha=\angle AYX$, $\beta=\angle BXY$. Since the ray $XB$ lies closer to $XY$ than $XA$, we have $\alpha+\beta<90^\circ$. Also $AX\perp AP$ and $XZ\perp ZP$, so $A,X,Z,P$ lie on the circle with diameter $XP$.

The angles $\angle AZX$ and $\angle APX$ subtend the same chord $AX$ and are equal (both $P,Z$ lie on the same side of $AX$). Now $\angle APX=\alpha+\beta$ by triangle $XPY$ and the extension of $YP$. Since $XC\perp AZ$, the acute angle $\gamma=\angle CXY$ is $90^\circ-\alpha-\beta$.

The right triangles with hypotenuse $XY$ give $BY=\sin\beta$, $CY=\sin\gamma=\cos(\alpha+\beta)$, $AY=\cos\alpha$ and $AX=\sin\alpha$. The sine rule in $XPY$ gives $XP=\sin\alpha/\sin(\alpha+\beta)$; in $XQY$ it gives $XQ=\sin\alpha/\sin(\alpha+\gamma)=\sin\alpha/\cos\beta$.

After multiplying the desired sum by $\sin\alpha$, its left side becomes $\sin\beta\sin(\alpha+\beta)+\cos\beta\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\cos\alpha$. This is also $\sin\alpha\cdot AY/AX$, proving the result.
stepsZh: 将 $XY$ 归一化为 $1$，记 $\alpha=\angle AYX,\beta=\angle BXY$。从 $X$ 看，射线 $XB$ 比 $XA$ 更靠近 $XY$，故 $\alpha+\beta<90^\circ$。又 $AX\perp AP$、$XZ\perp ZP$，所以 $A,X,Z,P$ 在以 $XP$ 为直径的圆上。
$\angle AZX$ 与 $\angle APX$ 同对弦 $AX$，且 $P,Z$ 在直线 $AX$ 同侧，故两角相等。由三角形 $XPY$ 在 $P$ 处的外角知 $\angle APX=\alpha+\beta$。因 $XC\perp AZ$，得锐角 $\gamma=\angle CXY=90^\circ-\alpha-\beta$。

以 $XY$ 为斜边的各直角三角形给出 $BY=\sin\beta$、$CY=\sin\gamma=\cos(\alpha+\beta)$、$AY=\cos\alpha$、$AX=\sin\alpha$。在 $XPY$ 中用正弦定理得 $XP=\sin\alpha/\sin(\alpha+\beta)$；在 $XQY$ 中得 $XQ=\sin\alpha/\sin(\alpha+\gamma)=\sin\alpha/\cos\beta$。
将待证等式两边同乘 $\sin\alpha$，左侧变为 $\sin\beta\sin(\alpha+\beta)+\cos\beta\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\cos\alpha$，而右侧 $\sin\alpha\cdot AY/AX$ 也等于 $\cos\alpha$，结论成立。

figure.alt: The semicircle has diameter XY. AY meets XB at P and XC at Q; Z is directly below P on the diameter.
figure.altZh: 半圆直径为 XY，AY 与 XB 交于 P、与 XC 交于 Q；P 在直径上的垂足为 Z。

usajmo-2013-q6.summary: Find all real triples with $x,y,z\ge1$ for which $\min\{\sqrt{x+xyz},\sqrt{y+xyz},\sqrt{z+xyz}\}=\sqrt{x-1}+\sqrt{y-1}+\sqrt{z-1}$.
usajmo-2013-q6.summaryZh: 求出满足 $x,y,z\ge1$ 及 $\min\{\sqrt{x+xyz},\sqrt{y+xyz},\sqrt{z+xyz}\}=\sqrt{x-1}+\sqrt{y-1}+\sqrt{z-1}$ 的所有实数三元组。

methods.title: Express the squared gap as two squares
methods.titleZh: 把平方差分解为两个平方项
steps: By symmetry assume $x$ is a smallest coordinate. Set $s=\sqrt{x-1}$, $u=\sqrt{y-1}$ and $v=\sqrt{z-1}$. The minimum on the left is $\sqrt{x+xyz}$. Both sides are nonnegative, so we may square.
The square of the left side is $(1+s^2)(1+(1+u^2)(1+v^2))$. Use $(1+u^2)(1+v^2)=(u+v)^2+(uv-1)^2$. On subtracting $(s+u+v)^2$ the exact difference is $(s(u+v)-1)^2+(1+s^2)(uv-1)^2$.

Therefore equality holds exactly when $uv=1$ and $s=1/(u+v)$. Writing $u=t>0$, $v=1/t$ gives the displayed coordinates. Conversely $1/(u+v)$ is smaller than both $u$ and $v$ when $uv=1$, since $u(u+v)=u^2+1>1$ and likewise for $v$. Hence the designated $x$ really is the minimum, both squares vanish, and every displayed permutation works.
stepsZh: 由对称性可设 $x$ 为最小坐标。令 $s=\sqrt{x-1},u=\sqrt{y-1},v=\sqrt{z-1}$。左侧最小根式即 $\sqrt{x+xyz}$。两边均非负，可将等式平方。
所以等号成立当且仅当 $uv=1$ 且 $s=1/(u+v)$。设 $u=t>0,v=1/t$，即得所列三元组。反过来，当 $uv=1$ 时，因 $u(u+v)=u^2+1>1$ 且 $v(v+u)>1$，故 $1/(u+v)$ 确实小于 $u,v$。于是所设 $x$ 确为最小坐标，两个平方均为零，所列各组及其排列都满足原式。
